description: Structural members including floor joists must be maintained structurally sound.
Structural members including rafters must be maintained structurally sound.
Structural members including studs must be maintained structurally sound.
Structural members shall be maintained structurally sound, free from deterioration, and must be capable of supporting the imposed dead and live loads.
Exterior walls must be free from holes, breaks, and loose or rotting materials, and must be maintained weatherproof and properly surface coated where required.
